text:
carmen: Heads-up — release window blocked. Staging e2e pipeline failing with what looks like a nondeterministic seed-related failure on integration-tests. Deploybot paused promotion.

deploybot: Promo paused: preflight_checks failed on pipeline `staging-e2e` build #4821. See https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4821 :warning:

jonah: Can anyone repro locally? I tried `PYTEST_RANDOM_SEED=42 pytest tests/integration/test_user_flow.py` and it's green for me.

kai: Seen it intermittently. Failing case: TestUserSessionExpiry — 3/50 runs. Stack trace snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 401, got 200
  tests/integration/test_user_flow.py:128
```

irene: Two possibilities: true test flake or underlying infra (cache/timeout) causing nondeterminism. CI logs show `Cache restore timed out after 60s` on one shard.

carmen: If it's infra, a rerun with clean cache might pass. If it's test-level nondeterminism, we either hotfix (xfail) or pin to last-good image. Note: change window ends in ~1h.

jonah: Good call — cache restore metrics are 98% hit but that one shard had repeated timeouts. I'll try a rerun without cache.

kai: Running: `deploybot rerun --job=staging-e2e --build=4821 --clean-cache`

deploybot: Rerun queued (job staging-e2e build 4821.re-run.1). ETA ~4m.

qa-bot: Rerun results: 2/5 runs still flaking (same test). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4821/rerun/1

irene: If it stays flaky, recommend hotfix to xfail the test + new image and manual promote. That preserves customer-facing changes and minimizes risk.

carmen: Decision tree: wait 30m for additional reruns; if >1 failure persists, we either (A) manual promote previous digest (rollback) or (B) cut hotfix branch that xfails test and promote. Which does ops prefer?

jonah: I can prepare hotfix branch and build image in ~20m. That seems faster than rollback + updating release notes and dealing with PM signoff.

carmen: OK. @lina FYI (PM) — we may cut a hotfix and update release notes to note the test xfail and follow-up fix.

deploybot: Promo remains paused. Manual override available: `/deploy override --reason "staging e2e flake"` — requires two approvals.

carmen: Thanks all. I'll update the release board and slack #product. Keeping thread open until hotfix image is ready or we revert to last-green.
